LanguageData.BowOfDeath_NoAmmo: No arrow of death loaded—cannot fire. Load an Arrow of Death or switch back to normal mode for melee.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_Busy: Aiming or firing; cannot switch modes.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_ModeDesc: Switch weapon mode. In Bow's Glimmer mode with shots remaining, the vanilla ranged attack command appears in the equipment bar; normal mode keeps melee only.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_StageDesc: Choose the charge stage for this shot. Higher stages increase damage, penetration and accuracy bonus, at the cost of longer aim time.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_NoStage: Charge stage data missing; cannot select.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_StatStageDesc: Ranged stats for the current stage. Reopen the info card after switching stages to refresh.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_StatModeDesc: Ranged shots are only possible in Bow's Glimmer mode; each shot consumes one Arrow of Death.
LanguageData.BowOfDeath_LoadDesc: Load {0} from your inventory into the weapon; each one grants one Bow's Glimmer shot.
